_readme: Optional description of the checkpoints in this folder.
A bare .pth file does not store its architecture, so anything the backend cannot
auto-detect is declared here. Keys starting with '_' are documentation only.
Full key reference: backend/README.md. After editing, POST /api/models/refresh.

best_resnet50_isl.pth._note: torchvision ResNet-50 trained on ISL still frames.
best_resnet50_isl.pth._data_format_note: torchvision models are NCHW. Only change this if the checkpoint was trained from NHWC tensors.

_note: Nothing is declared here on purpose: the backend inspects the checkpoint and infers
both the architecture (ResNet family / sequential MLP / LSTM / GRU) and the modality.
If /api/models reports status 'needs_manifest' for this entry, its `hint` field contains
the exact tensor shapes plus a ready-to-paste block for below — or run

movinet_isl_final_best.keras._note: MoViNet is a video model built from tf-models-official custom layers.

sign_language_model.h5._note: Legacy HDF5 Keras model; modality and input shape are read from the graph.
